column1: # past the +/-2% band for the first time since the 2026-08-26 regen. The
# render-load contract was already untouched at the time of filing:
# bench_draws_cmds 325 -> 330 (+1.5%, inside x1.1), bench_draws_batches
# 20 -> 20 (exact), bench_draws_gpu_calls 2 -> 2 (exact),
# light_count_point/light_count_directional 8/2 (exact). Live-captured this
# session (`--game oblivion --cell ICMarketDistrictTheGildedCarafe
# --bench-frames 240 --bench-hold`, cross-checked: byro-dbg `stats` stream
# and the engine's own `bench:` line both report entities=745, agreeing with
# the issue's own numbers — same cell, not a mis-attributed capture, #3560)
# and additionally ran `world.owners` for a per-ECS-class breakdown the
# original filing didn't have: `tlas_instances` (the actual rendered-instance
# count, printed on the `bench:` line itself as `tlas=330`) is 330 — i.e. the
# rendering-visible instance set grew by exactly the same +5 the draw-command
# count already showed, not by ~40. The remaining growth sits in
# non-rendering classes the `bench:`/draw-split evidence cannot see directly
# (`physics_bodies`=156, `transform_rows`=716 vs `cell_root_rows`=743 — the
# gap between spawned entities and rendered instances). This is the same
# "more bodies, not more visible geometry" signature as every prior instance
# of this pattern (RT-3/#1705, RT-8/#3554), now confirmed at the ECS-class
# level rather than only via the draw split. A full per-commit `git bisect`
# across the ~816 commits since the 2026-08-26 regen (`d6e16c90`) to name the
# exact root-cause commit was NOT performed — each step would need its own
# live engine rebuild+rerun, out of this pipeline's `cargo test` scope (see
# CLAUDE.md's smoke-test note) — so the specific spawner responsible remains
# uncited. `tex_missing_all_slots` also dropped 8 -> 0 (informational, not
# gated) consistent with #3555/RT-9's facegen fallback fix having landed
# since the row was last held. `bench_draws_raster_cmds` also moved (133 ->
# 22); this metric only gates via a `>= 3000` threshold check (see SKILL.md
# §Phase 3), so the drop does not cross the branch this baseline exists to
# catch. All other rows held.
# regenerated: 2026-09-03 (#3660 — measured raster-prefix command count; other rows held)
# regenerated: 2026-08-26 (#3288 — first live re-run since 2026-08-06; see
# docs/audits/AUDIT_RUNTIME_2026-08-26.md)
# entities_total 701 -> 705 (+0.6%, inside the +/-2% band) and the draw split
# moved DOWN on both gated axes: batches 47 -> 20, gpu_calls 4 -> 2. Recapturing
# a cell whose gated metrics improved tightens the contract; this is the only
# one of the five baselines regenerated this pass. fnv / fo3 / skyrim_se each
# carry a metric past a gating threshold in the WRONG direction and were left
# stale on purpose, so the evidence survives (RT-2026-08-26-01/02/04).
# #3550/RT-4 — `tex_missing_unique_paths` split into `tex_missing_base_color`
# (strict gate, comparable across the #3349 metric-surface widening) and
# `tex_missing_all_slots` (informational). See
# `.claude/commands/audit-runtime/SKILL.md` §Phase 3.
# #3555/RT-9 — `tex_missing_base_color` was 1 (the only genuine tex_missing
# delta across all five 2026-08-30-audited cells): `facegen\ears\human\
# earshuman.dds` (and its `_n` sibling) missed. Root-caused against the real
# archives (not guessed) — there is no `facegen\` top-level folder anywhere
# in Oblivion's BSAs; three vanilla NIFs (`earshuman.nif`, `earshighelf.nif`,
# `earswoodelf.nif`) bake in a FaceGen SDK export-tool path instead of the
# real `textures\characters\imperial\earshuman.dds`. Fixed with a
# basename-fallback lookup gated on the `textures\facegen\` prefix
# (`byroredux/src/asset_provider/{archive,texture}.rs`). Verified end-to-end
# against the real archive
# (`cargo test -p byroredux --bin byroredux facegen_tool_path -- --ignored`,
# both the diffuse and `_n` sibling now resolve) — row regenerated to 0.
# #3556/RT-10 — `light_count_directional` was derived from the mere presence
# of a `CellLightingRes` block, so it read a constant `1` on all five games
# and could never fail (#3424). The engine now parses the real per-emitter
# dump (`5f970bae`). Oblivion measures 2 directional / 8 point emitters
# (the two synthetic directionals are RT-11's finding, not a regression
# here). Added the new `light_count_point` row and corrected
# `light_count_directional` to the measured value.
# bench_fps_* is advisory only under xvfb (RT-2 / #1701) — never gate on it.
# entities_total: +/-2% tolerance metric, not exact (#1705 / RT-3).
# skin_pool_live: advisory, not a hard gate — see skin_pool_max /
# skin_pool_overflow_attempts instead (#3553 / RT-7).
